people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.
translations.bsb: So they hanged Haman on the gallows he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the fury of the king subsided.
translations.kjv: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
